BiblicalUsage: The word is supplication, prayer for grace and mercy. Solomon asks God to have respect unto the prayer of His servant and to his supplication, and to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer; Daniel says, whilst I was speaking, and praying, and confessing my sin, and presenting my supplication before the Lord; and the psalmist says, The Lord hath heard my supplication, the Lord will receive my prayer.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe supplication is prayer at its most honest: a cry for mercy, not a claim of merit. My position is that God hears supplication and receives it, and the praying man is never turned away empty.
